OUTREACH.DESCRIPTION: Send a message to a list on your WhatsApp QR number, at a pace that protects the number: opening hours, daily limits, random gaps and breaks.
OUTREACH.NEW_DESCRIPTION: Pick the number and write the first message. You set the list, the pace and the variations next, while the campaign is still a draft.
OUTREACH.SAVED: Saved. If the campaign was ready, prepare the list again.

PAUSED_REASON.session_down: The WhatsApp session of the number is disconnected.
PAUSED_REASON.send_failures: Three sends in a row failed.
PAUSED_REASON.session_not_found: The number has no WhatsApp session.

OUTREACH.PAUSED_HINT: Fix it and resume the campaign. Nobody who failed is sent again automatically.

FIELDS.NAME: Name
FIELDS.NO_NUMBER: No WhatsApp QR number found. Connect one first in Connections.

EXCLUSIONS.DESCRIPTION: Numbers your team does not want in any campaign. They are still answered normally when they write; this is not the same as asking to stop.
EXCLUSIONS.PHONES: Numbers (one per line, or separated by commas)

MESSAGE.TITLE: Message
MESSAGE.HINT_OPTIONS: and any column of your file. Pick a random option with
MESSAGE.HINT_BUBBLES: . A blank line starts a new message, up to 4. The versions take turns.
MESSAGE.COLD_HINT: People who never talked to you. The campaign can use only half of the number's daily limit.
MESSAGE.FOOTER_HINT: Added at the end of every message, for example: Reply STOP to stop receiving messages. Whoever answers with a stop word is blocked.

PACING.TITLE: Pace
PACING.HINT: The campaign can only be slower than the number's own limits, never faster. Hours follow the time zone of the number.
PACING.MAX_PER_DAY: Per day, at most (blank: the number's limit)

AUDIENCE.TITLE: List
AUDIENCE.CURRENT_IMPORT: Current list: {count} people from a file.
AUDIENCE.CURRENT_CRM: Current list: {count} contacts from the CRM.
AUDIENCE.FILE_HINT: CSV, XLSX or ODS, up to 10,000 rows, with the column titles in the first row. Save older XLS files as XLSX.
AUDIENCE.ROWS: {count} rows in the file. The first rows are shown above.
AUDIENCE.LABEL: Contacts with the label
AUDIENCE.APPLIED: List set: {count} people. Prepare the list to see who can receive.

REVIEW.TITLE: Review and start
REVIEW.TEST_HINT: Sends the first version to that number, with the data of the first person on the list. It does not count in the campaign.

REASON.invalid_phone: Phone number not in a valid format
REASON.duplicate: Same number as another person on the list
REASON.recently_contacted: Received a campaign in the last 30 days

RESULTS.TITLE: Results
RESULTS.RATES: Reply rate: {reply} of those sent. Failure rate: {failure}. WhatsApp by QR does not report delivered or read.
RESULTS.NAME: Name
